_about: What a correct import of 'VOYAH FREE.pdf' (20-page brochure) must produce. Used ONLY by the round-trip test; never copy values into app code. English values are exactly what the file says (including its own typos/truncations). Arabic: the file's text layer is damaged (Word/PowerPoint export), so Arabic is checked with 'ar_contains': the stored Arabic value must contain every listed token after normalisation (NFKC + lam-alef order fix).

suspension_system.en: Adaptive Air Suspension with adjustable ride height (depending on trim

interior_features_en: Electrically Adjustable Front Seats with Heating, Ventilation, and Massage

notes: Interior: the Arabic column has 'seating' and 'wheelbase' as its first two bullets and then 6 feature bullets — pair English and Arabic bullets by position within each section when the counts match.

Smart driving: English has 8 items, Arabic has 9 (an extra night-vision item). When counts differ, pair what matches by order and keep the extra Arabic item as an Arabic-only list item. Never drop it.
Lines without a leading bullet are continuations of the previous bullet (wrapped text). Join them.
Section headings are matched case- and whitespace-insensitively ('SUSPENSION  & Chassis' = 'SUSPENSION & CHASSIS').
'Claimed Fuel :' — a space before the colon is still a label separator.
Page 1: the vehicle name and the year are on separate lines; the year is the 4-digit line.
